phase: Phase 5 - Deep Intent Invariants & Anti-Regression Verification
invariantFormula: V = A ∧ T ∧ F ∧ I ∧ D ∧ E

invariantSubsystems.rule: AST assertions cannot be deleted, commented out, or weakened to generic true
Repaired locator must target element with equivalent functional role and accessible name
Action must succeed without triggering secondary uncaught runtime exceptions
Order of user actions (click, fill, select) must match original test chronological order
Action payloads (text values, quantities, query terms) cannot be mutated (e.g. 5 -> 1)
Intermediate navigation or action steps cannot be deleted or skipped to force a pass
